action.sql: SELECT date_trunc('week', received_date) AS wk, count(*) AS n, avg(is_late::INT) AS late_rate, avg(delay_days) AS avg_delay, avg(is_short::INT) AS short_rate, min(received_date) AS first_d FROM delivery WHERE supplier_id='SUP-001' AND received_date BETWEEN '2025-02-15' AND '2025-03-20' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
